view.label: View
view.docsNeedModel: Choose a model — the manuals are indexed by vehicle family.

hint.vehicle: Choose a vehicle. Applicability is evaluated against it, so nothing is filtered until one is picked.
hint.assembly: Choose an assembly from the list — engine, bodywork, interior and so on.
hint.plate: Choose a plate. Each one is a drawing within this assembly.
hint.emptyAssemblyLead: Nothing on this assembly fits this vehicle.
hint.emptyAssemblyBody: Its plates apply to other variants of the model, which is normal: for this vehicle {{available}} of {{total}} assemblies have parts. Pick another, or untick hide to see the empty ones.

plate.needBuildNumber: Enter a build number above to settle the date-based ones.
plate.needFactoryTail: as well — a build number cannot be compared without one.

drawing.notFound: Drawing not found in this tree.
drawing.noPositions: No callout positions on record for this drawing.

language.note: The language of the application's own text. The catalogue's own words — criterion names, assembly names, part descriptions — come from the tree and are chosen below.
language.catalogueNote: Criterion names, assembly names and the menu come from langue/<code>/. Changing this reopens the tree, which takes a moment — the vocabulary and the menu are read again.
